intro: I am interested in the Data Engineer contract role with NTT DATA in Dallas. The position aligns with my background in AWS data platforms, Spark/PySpark, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT, data migration, reconciliation, data quality validation, and stakeholder-facing delivery.
body: At Citi, I built and supported Python, SQL, PySpark, and AWS-oriented data pipelines that ingested telemetry from more than 6,000 infrastructure endpoints and transformed raw operational data into curated reporting, analytics, and forecasting datasets. I also designed AWS data platform components using S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Oracle, and PySpark to support scalable transformation and business-facing reporting.

Your role emphasizes migration from on-prem DataLake to AWS-hosted Lakehouse, SQL and Spark pipeline refactoring, data transfer integrity, reconciliation frameworks, SCD Type 2 concepts, schema evolution, partitioning, Parquet, Hadoop, and stakeholder validation. My experience maps well through ETL modernization, SQL optimization, schema design, validation workflows, production troubleshooting, documentation, and cross-functional sign-off across high-volume enterprise data pipelines.

I want to be direct about fit: my strongest production background is AWS Glue/S3/Athena/Redshift with PySpark and SQL rather than deep Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Kafka, Kubernetes, or Sybase IQ ownership. Where I would bring immediate value is AWS lakehouse migration execution, scalable Spark/PySpark processing, data reconciliation, SQL troubleshooting, data quality validation, documentation, and dependable delivery for business-facing data products.
conclusion: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my AWS, PySpark, SQL, data migration, reconciliation, and data quality background can support NTT DATA's Dallas lakehouse migration effort.
